none: PAS CAM-F9B25E: Roman Coin : Silver siliqua of Valentinian I, RESTITVTOR REIP
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver siliqua of Valens, AD 364-367 (Reece period 19). Reverse reads RESTITVTOR REIP. Reverse shows Emperor with labarum and Victory. Mint is Lyon. RIC IX, p. 42, no. 6e; P. Bastien, Le monnayage de l'atelier de Lyon, p. 187, no. 11. Obverse shows pearl-diademed draped bust right. Obverse legend reads [DN VALEN]-S P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: - -//PLVG. Die axis is 6 o'clock.…
